options.text: Energy demand should be reduced first; adding renewables to a wasteful building is inefficient
options.rationale: Correct: reduce demand before adding supply (fabric first).

options.text: Solar panels never generate any energy
options.rationale: Solar panels do generate energy; the issue is unreduced demand.

options.rationale: Green buildings use energy; the aim is to use it efficiently.
